digest.component_or_area: DC (Jira Data Center) outbound differ and sanitizer
propositions: DC lacks convergence suites that verify oversized comments and descriptions truncate identically across two passes, leaving it vulnerable to re-emission loops like those Cloud's existing suites hardened against

DC binds both comment and description sanitization to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT without documenting that 32767 is the documented default of Jira's jira.text.field.character.limit property (which covers both fields per jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519)

injecting a DC backend into convergence tests via config fallback silently resolves to Cloud because compute_outbound_mutations and _diff_comments lack explicit sanitizer/mapper parameters, causing tests to pass while exercising the wrong backend
DC's truncation mechanism and Cloud's are byte-identical for comments (same limit 32767, same suffix ' … [truncated by reconciler]') making value-based assertions unable to detect a backend fallback
DC fits plain characters at 32767 while Cloud fits ADF-serialized size at 32000, enabling a value-based discriminator for description convergence but requiring identity/recording checks for comments
